notes.title: (1.1.1) House Cleaning Update
notes.content:
New Features:


 Added 4 more save chests in Smith Senior's loot room in the main hub World.

Resolved Issues:


 Bug Report option is now selectable in the demo version
 Moving ladders can spawn in, not moving.
 Flying Archer Pellet Bot shooting bullets in the wrong direction
 Cleaned up collision issue across several Stages.
 Fixed up Camera Views  across several Stages.
 Wave bombers Respawn as their default skin in stages with Wave Archers, Firemen, and Soldiers.
 Player can not bounce in moving spring platforms, instead standing on top of them.
 Glob Spitter No longer move off platforms or go through walls.
 Player does not take damage from Wave Vine wiper.
 All Experiment Lab Miniboss skip their explosion animation.
 Clockwork Miniboss death not displayed correctly.
 Gravity Bot Miniboss explodes upon enter the boss room.
 Corrected the direction of the moving lava cannisters in Factory stage. (They no longer move out of  the intended area).
 Fixed orbit desync of wrecking ball and rotating spark column hazards.

Qol Improvements:


 Mevilen’s Projectiles move slower.
 Stick and Hammer Gernade now explode in contact with explosive blocks instead of bouncing off.
 Clean up Wave Vine Wiper animation to be more predicable, and they can’t changed direction after fired.
 Correct the range of the flying fryer bot’s flame thrower.
 Moved Item Description to be out in the open in the Weapons with the need of hitting the W key.
 Add Notification Prompt when a Boss or Mini Boss is defeated.
 Item Descriptions now displayed in crafting guide NPCs in the hub world
 Tutorial NPCs added in introstage to guide new player with the moveset

Miscellaneous:


Add more art detail in Jungle stage
Revised Charged Cacti Bullets
 Updated tossed Stick and Hammer Gernade Sprites
 Added new notification window when a Boss or MiniBoss is defeated.
 Removed Kill and Death Counters

notes.title: (1.1.0) Big Overhaul Update (March 30th)
notes.content:
New Features:


 Added New Zamboni Mini Boss in the Arctic Stage.
 Added New Donut Mini Boss in the Desert Stage.
 Added Boss tracker next to the stage select in the Hub World
 Added Save Chest in room with Dr. Smith Senior, Can now store items and have it be saved with game progress!
 Killed enemies can now respawn, making exploring areas again in the world more of a thrill!



Resolved Issues:


 Piranha Mini boss dies when spawn in if pong boss if defeated in Power plant.
 Dash through boss door for  Water Tank Mini boss.
 Gear Gun is not shooting when not aiming straight
 Player not taking damage from falling spikes
 Player getting stuck on the side of walls in morph ball mode.
 Paranah Mini boss can go outside the boss room when jump at the door
 Red Glob Mini Boss Fails to Re spawn
 Orbie Kong not facing the right direction when following player.
 Fix low FPS in Arctic Stage
 Fixed Jelly Fish movement and collision
 Inventory Items, Health, and Game Difficulty no longer carry over to created Files.
 Bullets not shooting in the correct direction  while walljumping when wearing a helmet
 


Qol Improvements:


 Ask the player if they want to remap or view controls before starting a new game.
 Cursor Movement is more predictable in Weapons Menu (Wraps on the current row or column its on)
 Pirates get stronger as difficulty progresses.
 Adjust some of the camera views in the stages.
 Chest item spawning modified, containing either more health upgrades or parts depending on where the chest is. Allows a wider range of objects to be obtains in each stage.
 Update item spawning from all enemies to drop more variant objects.
 Updated Sprite of many inventory items
 Add more detailed scrolling backgrounds.
 Explosions look cooler.



Miscellaneous:


 Reworked layout of Desert Stage to be more accessible to new players (Removed Color Block Gimmick)
 Reworked layout of  Factory Stage to be more accessible to new players (Removed Horizontal Crushers)
 Reworked layout of  Gravity Stage to be more accessible to new players (Less Spike pits and moving platforms.)
 Reworked layout of Biology  and Final Stages for more platforming opportunities.
 Reworked some visuals of Biology Lab Stage tiles.
 Raised the water in Para nah Miniboss Room in Powerplant
 Water Tank now has bubble bounce attack
 Wasp copter is much faster, with new bullet sprites and cooler death animation
 Add numerous enemies across all stages.
 Gear weapon will disappear after a certain time.
 Killing Gernade Droppers cause a huge explosion.

notes.title: (1.0.5) QOL update. (November 30th)
notes.content:
Bug Fixes :


 Fire Ball, and Nitro Dash did not destroy enemies, instead player took damage.
 Wave Snipers Bullets were not going in the correct direction.
 Being clipped into walls by a moving platforms and walls.
 Getting out of bounds by dashing in the map border.
 Blockbot can respawn after player death.
 Wave bombers running inside of walls when player pauses opens chest etc. (Occurs whenever the player is deactivated while the wave bomber is running)
 Camera can pan out of bounds.
 Scrolling Backgrounds can be offset incorrectly when spawning into a stage from another checkpoint.
 Roomba Bots can clip into ceilings and floors. (Their gravity speed was not capped properly).


Resolved Issues:


 Fixed even more broken Collision and Damage areas.
 Moving Saw will move out of place.
 Rolling wheels don’t get destroyed on saws.
 Corrected Damage Values of Anchor Arm Weapons
 Lemon Licker Weapon Lemon spins slower while bounce around.


Qol Improvements:


 Greenhouse - Moved a checkpoint platform in another that was too close to another checkpoint platform.
 Camera movement is much smoother. Going into camera locked sections of stages have a smoother movement transition instead of snapping into place.


Miscellaneous:


 Revises visuals and layout for Electric Greenhouse stage.
 Revises visuals and layout for Swingers Palace stage.
 Silver/Gold Chains can now be reverse engineer to Silver/Gold wires.
 Changed Desert Music.

notes.title: (1.0.4) A BIG House Cleaning Update (October 26th)
notes.content:
Bug Fixes (General):


 Dialogue starting on the second text box when talking to NPC’s again.
 Player not taking damage from Johnson’s rocks and explosions.
 Player not taking damage from grenades' explosions form grenade droppers.
 Saved data can be carried between save file after exiting back to the menu and selecting another file.
 Menu Left and Menu Right buttons were not being reassigned properly in the menu settings
 Addresses FPS drop in Ocean Stage (Related to bubble particles in the sea).
 Stage select platform activation is not being assigned correctly to the “climb up” key
 Johnson, Wilson, Bounty, Shane, and Crain being marked wrong after beaten on save file.
 Armor disappears on player when using Crain weapons.
 Boss Cutscene progress button not properly assigned on modified keyboard controls.
 NPC dialogue progress button not properly assigned on modified keyboard controls.
 Spring jump button not properly assigned on modified keyboard controls.
 Not proceeding to the Mettrex Stage 2 after beating Mettrex Stage 1 boss.
 Plop sound effect from Glob Poper and Ploppy Bomber not assign the sound audio option.
 Chest Select sound effect not assign the sound audio option.
 Game difficulty getting reset to zero when loading a file.
 Jump pushed the player down in the quick sand pit.
 Clock Fryers are not getting destroyed instantly when health is at zero.
 Drill Walker Heads did no damage.
 Color switch, Laser, Trapdoors, Double Jump and Spring SFX not assign the sound audio option.
 Miniboss Health Bar still on screen after mini boss is killed off.


Bug Fixes (Collision):


 Wall Clipping can occur involving releasing left or right keys near a wall.
 Can Dash through boss doors.
 Can clipping into walls by dashing and double jumping into a ceiling spikes.
 Golden Drill Mechs will fall through the floors.
 Fixed Collision in the upper area of the Powerplant, and certain sections in the sea in Ocean Stage.
 Removed Invisible Collision over trapdoors in Construction Stage.
 Can clip into the floor by jump next to a quick sand Pit.
 Can jump into ceiling with turning gear platform underneath it (Be performed in Factory Stage).
 Player and Wave Bomber can clip into ceiling into 2 block spaces.
 Clip into walls while on moving ladder that goes by walls.
 Claw arms can still present after Crain dies.
 Clip into ceiling in morph ball with moving platform moving up from the edge.


Resolved Issues:


 Wheeler missing score and explosion upon execution.
 Removed broken tiles at the end of Mettrex Stage 1.
 Fixed Deck Fence Tiles in Mettrex Stage 2.
 Replaced Debug Chest with Rarity Chest in Construction Stage.
 Removed Checkpoint platforms below first Truck in Construction Stage Part1.
 Fixed broken tiles in Powerplant.
 Powerplant - Removed death blocks in small room in upper area.
 Stage select left and right buttons were swapped.
 Death Barrier and invisible walls were added to desert stage
 Giant Drills not doing damage to player in pipeline stage boss.
 Crain getting stuck after performing wall grab move.
 Octopus Miniboss didn’t shoot projectiles in Ocean Stage.


Qol Improvements:


 Added Remapping for game controllers.
 Optimized written code for Chests.
 Settings configurations save after closing the game and load upon relaunching the Game.


Miscellaneous:


 Speed up Johnson’s walking animation.
 Johnson now has a secondary rock crush attack. (Creates a wall of rocks).
 Boss Health now increase over the course of the game (+10 for every main boss defeat).
 Can now use the jump button to release the Crain weapon from the attached wall.
 Revised Sea Bounty’s and Shane’s entrance before the boss fight.
 Lowered Pitch of Brewery Music.
 Update Charge for all hammer/mallet type weapons to be a giant hammer that swing in front of the player.
 Clean up a messy and bland platforming section in Mettrex Stage Part 2 
 Replaced Crain’s crouch attacks with two different quad grab attacks (Makes the Crain Boss fight more challenging when he’s at low health),
 Add more frames to Sock em Bots punches in the Brewery Stage.

notes.title: (1.0.3) House Cleaning Update 2 (September 30th)
notes.content:
New Features:


 Added more rooms to the Temple, Ocean Stages.
 Adjusted areas in Desert and Brewery Stages with more platforming opportunities and areas.


Bug Fixes:

 Tookie and Pellet Bot enemies not shooting bullets.

 Nitro Blazer Dash Shield occurs if you have Sapphire Chestings, NOT the Sapphire Helmet.

Resolved Issues:


 Brewery Stage - Missing Conveyor Trigger.
 Brewery Stage  - Removed Invisible wall blocking chest in Vents.

Qol Improvements:


 Better Camera views in many areas of all the stages.

Miscellaneous:


 Add more enemies to Desert, Temple and Brewery Stages.

 Bulb Busters and Bombers  create 12 small bullets in different directions upon impact.
 All spike ball weapons are stronger, (double damage output).

notes.content:
Rarity Chests have been added! These are hard to reach chests that contains more hard to come by items like armor sets, gem stones, or other items to create more powerful weapons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37334725/821063259c7ec6afacd990bacde4c46b5704a3ed.png

Other House Cleaning

 Gears causing tones of explosions sounds to play at the beginning of the Factory, Construction Part 2, and Ocean Stages.

 Gear Weapon not doing any damage to Wave Blockers.
 Added another safeguard from clipping after being hit in morphball from 1.0.0, (Was seen again in 1.0.1).

 Some collision issues in the Sky City, Ocean, Biology Lab, and Desert Stages.

 Wheels going in the wrong direction in Construction part 1.
 Crusher came out of place in the Factory Stage
 Missing numerous Objects in Biology Lab Stage…

 More Details to the Desert Stage, along with some graphical errors.

 Can make Gold Rod from Gold Crowbars

notes.title: XECUTER!
notes.content:
XECUTER Overview 

XECUTER is a complete overhaul of XECUTE (now going by XECUTE-LEGACY EDITION), that looks to improves core-game, while adding tone of new layouts and feature as well

Presentation Improvements: Enhanced visuals and UI elements to make the gaming experience more immersive and visually appealing.

Quality of Life (QoL) Enhancements: Various tweaks and adjustments aimed at improving the overall user experience, making gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.

Performance Boosts: Consistent 60 frames per second (fps) ensures a smoother and more fluid gameplay experience, enhancing responsiveness and reducing lag.

Crafting System: The introduction of a comprehensive crafting system adds depth to gameplay by allowing players to create a wide range of items, including over 400 different weapons, 6 new armor sets, and numerous other useful items. This feature likely encourages exploration, resource gathering, and experimentation as players strive to craft powerful gear.

What will happen to XECUTE - LEGACY EDITION


XECUTER will occupied the default branch once the releases rolls around on April 20th, 2024, while the Legacy Edition will be moved new branch and can be playable by entering the following code.

Beta Branch: 

Not only new player can still experience the Legacy Edition, but existing players that already got the game can experience the Special Edition with a simple update.

Default Branch: This branch will host the updated version of XECUTER, featuring all the improvements and additions introduced in the April release.

Legacy Edition Branch (Beta Branch): The Legacy Edition will be moved to the Beta Branch, if  layers interested in experiencing the Legacy Edition can do so by entering a specific code or selecting the appropriate branch in their game client.

Code:  pineapple1234

Existing players who already own the game will have the option to experience XECUTER can simply update their game client. This ensures that they can seamlessly transition to the new version without any hassle.
